title: Event-schema evolution: check old consumers and business effects
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Mix producer/consumer schemas; choose compatibility checks before introducing a new producer.
sourceRequirement: Ensure new producers remain compatible with old consumers during overlap.
sourceAcceptance: Events remain interpretable and effects correct across overlap; incompatible producers are blocked before expansion.
preconditions: Browser-openable standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript; no server or account.
Old producer intends 1250 cents; new producer intends 2500 cents to account-synthetic.
Every matrix cell is an independent hypothetical consumer journey, not repeated broker delivery.
Old readers require amountCents; new readers support amountCents and amountMinor.
The 7500-cent test-ledger sum is not a real account balance.
actions: Choose additive, renamed or unit-drift new payload; tolerant or strict old reader.
Choose full contract/effect, shape-only or new-consumer-only checks and complete or withheld-old observations.
Start and manually inspect four pinned matrix cells.
Request introduction; complete passing compatibility evidence alone permits the synthetic expansion.
Check one prediction separately, retain another attempt, or explicitly reset all.
syntheticInput: learning/S056/model.js: fixed evt-old / evt-new, account-synthetic and integer cents
assertions: Additive payloads with tolerant old readers preserve interpretation and intended effects in all four pairings.
Renamed fields or strict old readers fail visibly before introduction.
Integer-shaped dollar/cents drift is interpretable but fails business-effect assertions.
Shape-only, new-only and withheld-old receipts cannot establish compatibility.
An observed failure dominates later successful or unknown receipts.
Early/repeated actions, unsupported input and inconsistent forged state are rejected without mutation.
Predictions never rewrite observed outcomes or expansion decisions.
Eight attempts retain configurations and receipts without silent pruning; reset restores all defaults and keyboard focus.

iac.stage: After genuine loadable-stub assertion RED and before implementation

limits: Finite in-memory compatibility model; no real broker, registry, protocol, schema enforcement or business effects.
No fan-out, delivery guarantees, ordering, retries, real authentication, registration, credentials or durable history.
No cloud, IaC, scaffold, identity, deployment, expenditure, package/framework changes or source-parent certification.
B-S056 and D-S056 remain separate and incomplete; one frozen S unit only.
Raw CRLF provenance is preserved separately from canonical Git-source integrity qualification.
Browser helper has its published unattended lifecycle limitation; no abandoned prototype is used.
Ordinary verification is read-only to proof; CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 explicitly refreshes browser observations.
